_comment: Real material consumption ratios derived from 5 Lithuanian interior renovation projects (2024). Ground truth = contractor pasiūlymas quantities.

glaistymo_kampai._description: Corner bead strips (kampų profiliai) — measured in linear meters
glaistymo_kampai._unit: m per m² of total paintable area (walls + ceilings)

P1.note: outlier – molio tinkas adds many extra corner beads

glaistymo_kampai.recommended_ratio_note: m kampų per m² dažymo (P1 excluded as outlier). Use when Vision corner count unavailable.
glaistymo_kampai.outer_to_total_note: Multiply isoriniu_kampu_vnt by 3.5 to estimate total corner count when Vision only reports outer corners.

gkp_lubos._description: GKP (gipskartonio plokštės) luboms — drywall for ceilings
gkp_lubos._unit: m² of GKP vs m² of ceiling area
gkp_lubos.note: GKP area ~1.32× ceiling area due to 10% material waste + dropped sections + niche fascias. Formula: sheets = CEILING(ceiling_m2 × 1.32 / 3.0)

glaistymas_dazomas._description: Glaistymas (skimming putty) and dažymas (painting) — measured in m²
glaistymas_dazomas._unit: m² of treated surface vs m² of floor area
glaistymas_dazomas.note: Walls+ceilings paintable area ≈ 3.5–4.5× floor area. Use 3.8 as default. Lower for open-plan, higher for many small rooms.

hidroizoliacija._unit: count of wet zones per apartment size
hidroizoliacija.note: Expect ~1 wet zone per 50 m² floor area. Each zone: floor full + wall splash 0.3m + shower full height.

rotband_tinkas._description: Rotband (gypsum plaster) for walls — where used instead of GKP
rotband_tinkas.note: Rotband area ≈ floor area (used on one layer of walls in some zones). Not all projects use Rotband.
